name: field-projection
prompt: Mobile clients want smaller payloads. Extend GET /session in main.go with an optional query parameter fields: when fields=user, respond with only {"user": ...} from the session; when fields=id, only {"id": ...}; when the parameter is absent or has any other value, respond with the full session as today. A comma list like fields=id,user returns both keys. Field names are case-sensitive lowercase. Do not change session.go. Malformed requests keep their current behavior.
